F1.bar: p50 <= 16.7 ms AND p95 <= 25 ms over >= 600 rAF deltas after 45 s settle, at EVERY station.
F1.overallReason: F1 is an every-station gate. overview-52km-island missed BOTH percentiles -- p50 16.8 against 16.7, p95 25.2 against 25 -- so the gate fails as a whole even though four of five stations passed comfortably.
F1.wasThisPreDeclared: YES. The pre-registration recorded, before any capture, that far-tier-dominated stations MAY FAIL F1 and that T005 had read p95 up to 198 ms at far-tier poses. The failing station is the 52 km island overview, the maximum-residency pose, where the far tier holds essentially the whole island. This is the pre-declared outcome arriving, not a surprise, and the bar was not moved to accommodate it.
F1.marginHonesty: The miss is small -- 0.1 ms on p50 and 0.2 ms on p95 -- and it is recorded as a FAIL rather than rounded into a pass. A bar with a tolerance nobody registered is not a bar.

F2.disposition: INTERPRETATION RULE, NOT A BAR, exactly as registered.
F2.reading: The about:blank control in the SAME session read p50 8.3 ms and p95 10.0 ms over 1,440 samples. Every station's percentiles sit well above that, so NO station is instrument-limited: the numbers are the scene's, not the harness's ceiling. The harness marks instrumentLimited false at all five.
F2.notAClaim: This is not a 'capped control' bar and is not scored.

F4.disposition: REPORTED, and a NAMED CARRY of D-11.
F4.carry: Max doubleDrawMs 6,165.2 ms against the inherited 4,000 ms leg-Y bar. F4.openQuestionAnswered: NOT YET. Whether doubleDrawMs now includes far-tier covered-set work was pre-registered as a question to answer by reading the instrumented path. It is not answered by this capture and is carried.

committedGSeriesScopeFinding.headline: THE COMMITTED G1/G2/G3 GATES FAIL IN A THREE-TIER SCENE FOR A SCOPE REASON, NOT A REGRESSION, AND THEIR FAIL MUST NOT BE READ AS ONE.

G1.why: G1 validates the texture probe by predicting texturesByteLength from a KNOWN COUNT of wave class tiles. It attributes every texture byte to those tiles. With the far tier armed, 263,017,553 bytes of far-tier atlases are in the same total, so the prediction is short by exactly that. 263,367,077 - 263,017,553 = 349,524 = 4 x 87,381, the predicted four-tile value to the byte.

G2.why: Same cause. A bar of 2,184,525 bytes against a measurement of 283,552,146 implies 3,245 class tiles where 24 were expected; the far tier's island-scale atlas residency is being read as wave class tiles.

committedGSeriesScopeFinding.consequence: These gates are FAR-TIER-BLIND, which the pre-registration named as the reason a new harness was required at all. Their FAIL is an instrument-scope failure and is recorded as such. The VALID GPU validation for this campaign is G1-far, which isolated the far tier with exteriorStreaming=off in both arms and passed at EXACTLY ZERO over 839 tiles; B3/B4/B5 rest on that, not on these.
committedGSeriesScopeFinding.whatWouldFixThem: A wave-tier byte reading that excludes far-tier atlases -- which needs either a per-source breakdown in the probe or an isolation hook. Both are runtime changes, which this campaign may not make. Named, not attempted.

threeTierCompositionRequirement.requirement: At least one station genuinely carrying all three tiers with camera height below the 450 m bucket boundary, or an explicit statement that none exists.
threeTierCompositionRequirement.verdict: MET, AND VERIFIED BY DOM READ RATHER THAN ASSUMED.
threeTierCompositionRequirement.finding: street-260m-midtown and street-260m-w02-lower, both at 260 m of camera height, carry all three tiers simultaneously: dense massing active (251 and 154 buildings), exterior wave resident (8 cells), and far tier drawn (738 and 811 cells). Their publish sequences advanced (29 and 9), so these are live readings and not a stalled instrument.
threeTierCompositionRequirement.counterFinding: The three OVERVIEW stations are TWO-tier, not three: massingActive is 0 at 52 km, 2,400 m and 1,200 m, and at the P2 oblique pose. The dense layer holds nothing there. A campaign that assumed composition from geometry would have reported three tiers at all five stations and been wrong at three of them.

attemptDisclosure.attempt1: INSTRUMENT-FAILURE ABORT at G1 exterior activation. Cause: the harness's G1 scene opts into manhattan-exterior-cells-20260811-v3-s1, which was not staged. No station verdict written.
attemptDisclosure.attempt2: INSTRUMENT-FAILURE ABORT at the same point with all six -s1 packages staged and verified. Cause: `vite preview` serves dist/, and public/data is copied in at BUILD time -- packages staged after the build are on disk and invisible to the browser. Diagnosed by asking the page which URL failed rather than guessing again. No station verdict written.
attemptDisclosure.attempt3: COMPLETED. All five stations captured after a rebuild.
attemptDisclosure.rule: Both aborts are INSTRUMENT-FAILURE ABORTS under the registered classification: they wrote no verdict and were repeated with attemptCount incremented. Neither is a recorded FAIL, and no bar was touched.

nonClaims: One machine, one session, AC power. Not a distribution and no confidence interval.
F1's FAIL is a reading of this vehicle at this pose, not a claim about other hardware.
The committed G-series FAILs are scope failures of far-tier-blind instruments and are not evidence about GPU residency; B3/B4/B5 from G1-far are.
